1879064073.name: Merciful Strike
1879064073.desc: A powerful attack that can only be used on opponents under 20% health.

1879064329.name: Cunning Attack
1879064329.desc: Deals damage even after the initial strike.\n\nThe bleed deals more damage while Stealthed.

1879073289.name: Stealthed Surprise Strike
1879073289.desc:
Strike the enemy, dealing more damage from behind or when Stealthed.

Critical hits with Surprise Strike are more damaging than most skills.<RGB=#00ff00>

 +10% Positional Damage
 +100% Critical Magnitude</RGB>

1879097865.name: Howl of Unnerving
1879097865.desc: So great is the fear your howl can cause that you shatter the resolve of the mightiest of foes. Does not break stealth.

1879099273.name: Mentor: Drums
1879099273.desc: You can instruct someone how to play the drum.

1879140873.name: Quick Recovery
1879140873.desc: Allows Gambit change mid-stroke.\n\nThis skill removes the last Gambit from the Gambit Panel.

1879160841.name: Prized Galadhrim Pony
1879160841.desc: The Galadhrim have chosen to honour you with one of their prized ponies.

1879198345.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Spotted Sabre-cat)
1879198345.desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879206025.name: Purge Poison
1879206025.desc: Purges poisons from all allies in your fellowship. The magnitude of this skill is influenced by the target's level.

1879214601.name: Mighty Blow
1879214601.desc: A mighty blow that is difficult to avoid and deals damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879231369.name: Ranged Onslaught
1879231369.desc: A powerful javelin deals direct damage.

1879239561.name: Seeking Arrow
1879239561.desc: Steadying your mount, you attempt a well-placed shot at an enemy that will deal damage and apply a potentially harmful effect to your target.

1879241993.name: Staggering Slash
1879241993.desc: A brutal strike against rider and steed, this slash is meant to weaken your enemy, leaving them susceptible to further attack.

1879248009.name: Accurate Spear-toss
1879248009.desc: You take your time and aim at the target. You are sure to hit it.

1879260041.name: Eldarin Arrow
1879260041.desc: Through your knowledge of Elvish or dwarf-virtues, your arrow causes light damage over time.

1879263625.name: Lay Trap
1879263625.desc: Your skill in combat and experience with trapping allow you to lay snares on the go. You throw down a trap behind you that will last for a short period of time or until triggered by an enemy.

1879284233.name: Dissonant Piercing Cry
1879284233.desc: Your shout does light damage to your enemies and can interrupt their actions.

1879307145.name: Dusty Shrew
1879307145.desc: Summons a dusty shrew to brighten your day.

1879315081.name: Claw Swipe
1879315081.desc: With your claws out, you swing across a group of enemies, lowering their offences for a brief moment.\n\nThis debuff stacks up to 3 times.

1879328777.name: Steed of the Anórien Autumn
1879328777.desc: A pony from the Fall Festival.

1879329801.name: Blue Lizard
1879329801.desc: Summons a lizard to keep you company.

1879332617.name: Willem Whisker
1879332617.desc: Summons Bingo's favourite lynx friend to keep you company.

1879344393.name: Harvestmath Horse
1879344393.desc: A horse from the Fall Festival.

1879408649.name: Blackroot Steed
1879408649.desc: A proud steed of the Blackroot.

1879411081.name: Light Grey Goat
1879411081.desc: A little goat who would like to see the world with you.

1879416073.name: Muster in Trader's Wharf
1879416073.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Trader's Wharf

1879457545.name: Ranged Cauterizing Steel
1879457545.desc: A series of precision strikes hit your opponent with a red-hot weapon where already wounded.\n\nThis skill will consume any Power Attack, Mighty Blow, or Unerring Strike damage over time effects on your target, dealing bonus damage for each effect consumed.

1879466249.name: Sail to after-battle Osgiliath
1879466249.desc: Navigate to after-battle Osgiliath with nearby fellows.

1879468681.name: Fire-fox Bandit
1879468681.desc: Summons a mischievous fox to accompany you on your journeys.

1879489161.name: Challenge
1879489161.desc: Your companion lets out a terrifying bellow and forces many enemies to target them.

1879506569.name: Shadowy Simulacrum
1879506569.desc: Summon a shadowy simulacrum. The simulacrum will fight until defeated or its connexion to the material wanes.

1879506825.name: Grievous Wounds
1879506825.desc: Beguile and slash your target, leaving them bleeding while also restoring Morale.

1879521289.name: Rose-coloured Mûmak Calf
1879521289.desc: Summons a helpful rose-coloured mûmak calf to accompany you on your travels.

1879523209.name: Searing Call to Fate
1879523209.desc: Requires Dissonance or Melody Stance.\n\nDeals Light damage to a single target, with a high Critical chance.

1879529737.name: Shield-breaker
1879529737.desc: A mighty melee attack with great force, capable of shattering even the staunchest defence, though it won't be very effective against more nimble and lightly armoured foes.\nThis skill cannot be Blocked, Parried, or Evaded.
